description: This file defines a Python class `VisionImageFrameAggregator` that processes frame data, aggregating text and image frames into vision frames for multimodal processing within the Pipecat framework. It includes deprecation notices and relies on other Pipecat modules for frame handling and context management.

classes.name: VisionImageFrameAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator class that combines text and image frames into vision frames for multimodal processing. It is marked as deprecated and relies on other Pipecat frame and context classes.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the aggregator with no cached text; issues a deprecation warning.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes incoming frames. Caches text frames and combines them with subsequent image frames to generate vision frames. Passes through other frames unchanged.
